extracted.intended_audience: trademark applicants, trademark owners/holders, and their attorneys preparing and filing a TEAS Response to Office Action with the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and mandatory requirements for completing and submitting the USPTO TEAS 'Response to Office Action' form, including what information, attachments, signatures, and procedural steps are required and prohibited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Session timeout and inactivity handling
rubrics_metrics.description: You're required to log back in after 30 minutes of inactivity; after 25 minutes you'll be prompted to continue and if you do not continue within 5 minutes the session will end and you will lose any unsaved data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have all information ready before starting; save locally if not ready to complete; expect forced logout to protect user information and comply with federal security standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use only form navigation buttons
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not use your browser back/forward buttons; use only the navigation buttons at the bottom of each page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using browser navigation can disrupt the TEAS form flow and cause errors or data loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields and validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory and the form will not validate if these fields are not filled out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fill out all * fields; review validation page and Input Table prior to submission to confirm completeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form eligibility based on application status
rubrics_metrics.description: To use this form, the 'Current Status' of your application must be 'A Non-final Action has been mailed.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check TSDR to confirm status before proceeding; if not in the correct status wait 48-72 hours after receiving notice or you'll receive an error when continuing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serial number / saved form access
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the application serial number or access a previously saved form; do not enter a serial number if accessing a saved form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To upload a saved form file, follow TEAS Help instructions first; failure to follow TEAS Help instructions will result in inability to edit saved data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not attach improper files in generic upload
rubrics_metrics.description: Do NOT upload or attach any other file(s) (for example, a specimen or foreign registration certificate) using the initial 'browse' button; upload other attachments within the proper section after answering wizard questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attaching files in the wrong place causes processing delays and prevents correct data processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responses cannot consist only of a signature
rubrics_metrics.description: A RESPONSE WITH ONLY YOUR SIGNATURE IS NOT ACCEPTABLE except if the only issue raised was that the original filing was unsigned, improperly signed, or lacked required declaration language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Merely authorizing the examining attorney to make changes without specifying exact changes is not a proper response; address each ground raised in the Office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: When arguing against a refusal, answer Question #1 'Yes' and attach evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: You must answer 'Yes' to Question #1 to submit arguments against a refusal and, if necessary, attach supporting evidence to attempt to convince the examining attorney to withdraw the refusal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To submit a 'substitute specimen' to overcome a refusal, also answer 'Yes' to Question #2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of permissible amendments to identifications
rubrics_metrics.description: You may modify the identification of goods/services/collective membership organization only to clarify or limit; adding to or broadening the scope is not permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you need to broaden or add goods/services you must file a new application; attempts to broaden in response will be ignored or rejected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed changes flagged in Question #2
rubrics_metrics.description: Question #2 asks whether you need to change/delete class number; modify identification of goods/services; change filing basis; add/modify dates of use; submit a new or substitute specimen; submit a foreign registration certificate or proof of renewal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer 'Yes' appropriately; note special notes such as adding a class vs modifying existing class, and associated fee consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional statements (Question #3) usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Question #3 to add or delete disclaimers, colors claimed as a feature, description of the mark, stippling statements, claims of prior registrations, translations/transliterations, meaning/significance, Section 2(f) claims, consents, Supplemental Register amendments, concurrent use claims, and miscellaneous statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All selected items will display in the 'Additional Statement(s)' section; do not use this if also answering 'Yes' to #4 when attaching a new drawing; use miscellaneous only for attachments not covered elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: New drawing submission restrictions (Question #4)
rubrics_metrics.description: A material change to your mark is never permissible. Only minor changes in the mark are sometimes permitted. A drawing must be in JPG format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the change is material you will receive a refusal; only submit a new drawing when appropriate and in the required format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner/contact information updates (Question #5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Question #5 to correct or change the owner's/holder's name, entity information, mailing address, email address, phone or fax numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The email address of the owner/holder is the Primary Email Address for Correspondence if no attorney is appointed. If an attorney is appointed, only the attorney's email is used for USPTO correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding new class(es) constraints (Question #6)
rubrics_metrics.description: You may not add class(es)/goods/services or any descriptive language to broaden the scope of the current identification; to add a new class answer 'Yes' to #6 (and pay fees as required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To pay fees for additional classes answer 'Yes' to #7. To change an existing classification number or delete goods/services, use Question #2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee submission requirements (Question #7)
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer 'Yes' if you need to submit a fee for an existing or additional class due to a deficiency or to process a refused/charged back payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fees are processed after clicking Pay/Submit; payment screens follow submission and must be completed within 30 minutes of accessing the payment screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S.-licensed attorney requirement for foreign-domiciled owners (Question #8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign-domiciled owners/holders must have a U.S.-licensed attorney represent them before the USPTO in any application- or registration-related filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information about hiring a U.S.-licensed attorney is available on the USPTO website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signed declaration requirement (Question #9)
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer 'Yes' to Question #9 and submit a Signed Declaration if the application was unsigned, improperly signed, or lacked the required declaration language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A declaration is required for certain corrections; signatory must be a proper party to sign under Trademark Rule 2.193.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence must be submitted only in the Evidence section
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach ONLY supporting evidence or the response to a refusal to register in the Evidence/Evidence File section, not the entire response to the Office action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each portion of the form serves a specific purpose for data processing reasons; attaching whole responses or placing files in wrong sections will cause significant delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen submission and format rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach ONLY the specimen (not the entire filing); sound and motion specimens are not 'non-traditional' and must be submitted using this form; if mailing a non-traditional specimen via USPS, check the appropriate box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit USPTO website for acceptable file sizes and formats; describe what the specimen consists of in the provided field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webpage specimen requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If a specimen is a webpage, provide the webpage URL(s) and date(s) of access/printing if that information does NOT appear on the attached specimen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter date in MM/DD/YYYY format and include accurate URLs and access dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute/unverified specimen declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: If checking the box that specimens are now being submitted or were previously submitted unverified, the form automatically adds declaration language asserting the specimen(s) was/were in use as claimed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Willful false statements are punishable under 18 U.S.C. §1001; make truthful attestations only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing basis selection and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the rules for the chosen filing basis (Section 1(a) use in commerce, Section 1(b) intent-to-use, Section 44(d), Section 44(e), etc.); do NOT use this form to submit dates of use/specimen for an application originally filed under 1(b) unless responding to a specimen issue created by an already filed Allegation of Use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an Allegation of Use is not a proper response to an Office action; choose and follow the correct procedural route for basis-specific filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy and fraud warning for goods/services listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements made in filings must be accurate; inaccuracies (e.g., lack of bona fide intent to use or lack of use on all goods/services claimed) could result in cancellation of the registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not exceed the scope of the current identification; modifications can clarify or limit but not broaden the listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing format requirements for goods/services
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter only the common commercial name for goods/services (do not enter a Class code or any other code); if entering multiple listings separate with a semicolon (;) NOT a comma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include HTML or programming code; consult USPTO Goods and/or Services Manual for acceptable language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image and color claim requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: For special form/stylized marks attach a JPG image; if claiming color you must submit a color image and list colors beginning with a lower-case letter and state the location of each color; if not claiming color, check the box and leave the color field blank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Image size cannot exceed 5 megabytes; the image must include all elements of the mark; any literal element entered that is not in the image will not be considered part of the mark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of special form marks
rubrics_metrics.description: A complete and accurate description of the entire mark is required for all marks not in standard characters; description must include all literal and design elements and, for color marks, the nature and location of each color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin the entry with a lower-case letter; do NOT include the language 'The mark consists of' or a final period (the system adds those).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sound mark file requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a sound mark, click 'Browse/Choose File' to select the sound file in acceptable formats (.WAV, .WMA, .MP3, or .AVI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow file size/format guidance on the USPTO website for successful upload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner/holder mailing and domicile address rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Mailing address entered is publicly viewable in TSDR and must be capable of receiving mail; domicile address is not publicly viewable unless same as mailing address, and in most cases cannot be a P.O. box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate public mailing address; adjust entries to fit USPTO field character limits to avoid truncation and undeliverable addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character limits for data fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain fields have storage/character limits in the USPTO database (e.g., some fields limited to 40 characters, 22 characters, 150 characters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abbreviate where necessary (e.g., 'St.' for 'Street') to avoid truncation or invalid entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Email Address for Correspondence maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: The owner/holder (or the owner's/holder's attorney, if appointed) is responsible for maintaining a valid Primary Email Address for Correspondence; the USPTO is not responsible for non-delivery due to receiver systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only Primary Email is used for official communication; if attorney is appointed the USPTO will correspond only with the attorney.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and signatory eligibility rules
rubrics_metrics.description: If a declaration is required, it must be signed by someone who is a 'proper party to sign on behalf of the applicant' under Trademark Rule 2.193(a); choose one signature method and follow the format (e.g., electronic signature '/john doe/').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of acceptable signatures include /john doe/; /jd/; or /123-4567/. The signer must be properly authorized; if an attorney represents the applicant only the attorney may sign the response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro se and attorney signature confirmations
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner/Holder who is not represented must confirm they are the owner/holder or authorized to bind the owner and that any prior attorney has been revoked or withdrawn. Authorized U.S.-licensed attorneys must confirm bar standing and authority. Foreign attorneys (other than authorized Canadian attorneys/agents) may not sign or represent before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If more than one owner/holder ALL must sign the overall submission; follow the detailed advisory checkboxes about representation and appointment of associates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and validation steps before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Review data in various formats using links under Response Data, use the print function for records, review the Validation Page and Input Table for accuracy and completeness, and save the form locally if not ready to submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submission you cannot return to modify the form; use 'Save Form' to save data and reopen via new form browse option to continue later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement of important notices before filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Before submission you must acknowledge notices that the response should address each issue in the Office action, fees are nonrefundable, all information submitted becomes public record, and that you have no right to confidentiality for submitted information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the required box indicating you have read and understand these notices before clicking Submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warnings about character conversion and public disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: After submission some characters may be displayed differently because USPTO systems convert problematic characters to the closest acceptable equivalent; all submitted information becomes public and may be used by third parties for solicitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid entering sensitive banking/credit information except in secure payment screens; be aware of the public nature of submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment processing and nonrefundable fee policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If a fee is required, provide payment during the Pay/Submit process; once submitted, fees are not refundable because they are processing fees for substantive review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete payment within required time windows; successful transactions yield a SUCCESS screen and an email filing receipt within 24 hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: File attachment specificity and storage notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach only the specific document requested in each section (e.g., specimen file, foreign registration/proof of renewal, drawing image); do not attach entire filings or unrelated documents in those sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to attach the correct document in the correct section causes processing delays and may necessitate refiling.
